3–6 ✓Life Time UNBOUND GravelEmporia, KS · gravel · festival · 4 days · XL (~350 mi), 200, 100, 50, 25 miles; Juniors; Kids Crit.… · Emporia guide →Details
Dates
Thu, Jun 3 – Sun, Jun 6, 2027
Where
Emporia, KS
Distances
XL (~350 mi), 200, 100, 50, 25 miles; Juniors; Kids Crit. XL 350 mi starts Fri June 4 (evening)
Format
mass-participation gravel race / festival
Cause
Charity entries via partners (e.g., Chris Klug Foundation ‘CKF UNBOUND’ team; other partners not listed on site)
Organizer
Life Time
Series
Life Time Grand Prix (200-mile race is round 2)
Registration
Lottery. Opens Nov 1, 2026 10:00 AM CT; closes Nov 15, 2026 11:59 PM CT; results Nov 21, 2026. Life Time Club members early access from Oct 25, 2026. One entry per person; registration free to enter (card collected). 2027 entry fees ‘coming soon’.
Lottery
Yes — lottery Nov 1–15, 2026 (all distances incl. XL); results Nov 21, 2026. Guaranteed entry via: qualifier coins (Sea Otter Classic, Crusher in the Tushar, Heathland Gravel, Rad Dirt Fest, Big Sugar Gravel — 50+ coins each for 200/100), volunteering 10+ hrs at UNBOUND or Big Sugar (100 spots), charity entries (first-come), Life Time 6-month Club-Access membership, training camp packages.

DateOfficial site prints ‘June 3 – 6, 2027 | Emporia, KS’; the main 200/100/50/25 races are Saturday June 5, 2027 (BikeSignup 2027 CKF listing shows Sat Jun 5 – Sun Jun 6).

NotesFormerly Dirty Kanza (renamed 2020). 2027 routes ‘in the works’. Roughly 4,000 riders. Also a Life Time Grand Prix round (UNBOUND 200 presented by Shimano). Unbound XL (350 mi) runs Friday evening June 4 into Saturday.

The full pageEvent siteSources: unboundgravel.com unboundgravel.com
